article.story: AUBURN, Ala. -- — Kolby King and Tahaad Pettiford each scored 16 points and Auburn pulled away in the second half and beat Lipscomb 101-66 on Tuesday night. King shot 6 of 7 (4 of 5 from 3-point range) off the bench and Pettiford shot 7 of 11. He also grabbed six rebounds and distributed six assists with just one turnover. Kevin Overton added 15 rebounds and reserve Owen Freeman scored 10. Auburn finished 41-of-68 shooting — 60% — and had a 42-24 rebound advantage. Hugo Tidare scored 17 points and Takai Simpkins scored 15 for Lipscomb, whose 15 3-pointers made up 25 of their made shots. Simpkins made a 3-pointer with 9:27 left before halftime to bring Lipscomb within 29-27. Auburn responded with a 9-0 run and Adam Olsen's 3 gave the Tigers their first double-digit lead of the game three minutes later. Lipscomb drew within 38-32 when Mateo Esmeraldo made a layup and Sawyer Dotson followed with a 3. The Tigers outscored Lipscomb 9-5 to close the half and led 47-37 at halftime. Auburn took control and never relinquished it, outscoring the Bisons 16-8 in the first 4:45 after intermission. Up next Lipscomb: Travels to Columbus, Ohio to face Ohio State on Sunday. Auburn: Heads to Clemson to take on the Tigers on Monday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here. Visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college football coverage here.
